about.title: About Burke Self Storage
text: A 5x5 fits a closet's worth of items, a 10x10 holds a one-bedroom apartment, and a 10x20 fits a 3-bedroom home. Our team can help you size it right in under a minute — call or stop by.

Burke Self Storage on Burke Road, near Red Bluff Road, offers a wide range of unit sizes alongside smart units, climate-controlled space, and convenient drive-up access for Pasadena residents and businesses.

At Burke Self Storage, we make it easy to find dependable self storage and vehicle parking near your home, business, or neighborhood in Pasadena, TX. With flexible month-to-month leasing, simple online account management, and a convenient Burke Road location, getting organized has never been more straightforward.

Our facility sits on Burke Road near Red Bluff Road, directly across from Pomeroy Elementary School and just a short drive from the Pasadena Central Public Library and the Sam Houston Tollway. We sit just off Red Bluff Road and Southmore Avenue, a short drive from Southmore Intermediate School, and we proudly serve Pasadena and the surrounding Harris County area.

facts.heading: Access hours
facts.text: Gate access is open Monday to Sunday, 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM, using your personal gate code. The office is open Monday to Friday 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and closed Sunday.

facts.heading: Smart units
facts.text: Smart units at Burke Road are powered by Storage Defender, which watches your individual unit around the clock, sends real-time alerts to your phone by text rather than an app, and sounds a noise deterrent. Reply Yes or No to an alert and Storage Defender handles the rest.

facts.heading: How the facility is secured
facts.text: The property is monitored by 24/7 HD video surveillance, perimeter fencing, individually coded gate access, bright LED lighting, and motion sensors on every hallway.

facts.heading: Renting and moving out
facts.text: Rent online in a few minutes, or reserve a unit with no credit card required and switch sizes before you move in. All units are rented month-to-month, and you can move out any time with 10 days written notice — there are no long-term contracts or early termination fees.

facts.heading: Paying your rent
facts.text: Pay online through your tenant portal, by phone, in person at the office, or set up autopay with a credit card or bank account. Autopay tenants receive a small monthly discount, and we accept major credit cards in person.

facts.heading: Insurance on stored items
facts.text: Renters are required to have insurance for stored items, and we offer coverage through a third-party provider for convenience.

facts.heading: Moving and packing supplies
items: Bubble wrap, packing paper, and shrink wrap
Bundled sets that cost less than buying each item on its own
U-Haul moving truck rentals arranged through the office

facts.heading: What you cannot store
items: Flammable liquids such as propane and gas
Irreplaceable or high-value items such as important documents or jewelry

facts.heading: Who can reach your unit
facts.text: You can designate other people to access your unit or keep access to yourself. If you forget your gate code, come by the office during business hours with proof of identity and we will help. A unit is for storing items only, not for working, exercising, or spending time inside.

faqs.a: Tenants can access their units seven days a week from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM using their personal gate code.

faqs.q: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. All units are rented month-to-month. You can move out anytime with 10 days written notice — there are no long-term contracts or early termination fees.

faqs.q: How do I pay my monthly rent?
faqs.a: You can pay online through your tenant portal, by phone, in person at the office, or set up autopay with a credit card or bank account. Autopay tenants receive a small monthly discount.

faqs.q: What size unit do I need?
faqs.a: A 5x5 fits a closet's worth of items, a 10x10 holds a one-bedroom apartment, and a 10x20 fits a 3-bedroom home. Our team can help you size it right in under a minute — call or stop by.

faqs.q: What size storage units are available in Pasadena, TX?
faqs.a: Our Pasadena facility on Burke Road offers a wide range of unit sizes, from compact 5x5 units ideal for boxes and small items up to large 20x20 units that can hold the contents of a multi-bedroom home. We also offer uncovered vehicle parking for cars, trailers, boats, and RVs.
Yes. Climate-controlled units maintain a temperature between 55-80°F year-round, protecting electronics, wood furniture, documents, and other sensitive items from heat and humidity.
The property is monitored by 24/7 HD video surveillance, perimeter fencing, individually coded gate access, bright LED lighting, and motion sensors on every hallway.

faqs.q: Does your Pasadena, TX, facility offer vehicle and RV parking?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Pasadena facility provides uncovered parking spaces for a variety of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, trucks, trailers, boats, and RVs, giving you a convenient place to keep them close to home.

faqs.q: Do I need storage insurance when renting a unit?
faqs.a: Yes, renters are required to have insurance for stored items. For convenience, we offer coverage through a third-party provider.

faqs.q: How do I rent a moving truck?
faqs.a: Contact the Burke Road office to arrange a U-Haul moving truck rental.

faqs.q: Do your storage units have electrical outlets?
faqs.a: Most smaller units do not include outlets. Units 250 square feet or larger may have them. Contact the office for details.

faqs.q: What cannot be stored in self storage at our Pasadena, TX, facility?
faqs.a: Certain items are not allowed in storage units, including living things like plants or pets, perishable goods, and hazardous materials such as flammable liquids, chemicals, or explosives. Illegal items, firearms, and ammunition are also prohibited. It's best to avoid storing anything wet to prevent mold, as well as irreplaceable or high-value items like important documents or jewelry.
